services.name: School Tours
services.desc: One adult chaperon for every ten students will have their admission covered under our free tour guidelines; however, we are happy to apply our discounted tour rate of $10.50 to additional chaperons. When scheduling a tour, please provide your requested tour date and time, school name, teacher name, contact details, number of students, number of chaperons, and student grade level. Please inform us of any requests or accommodations you may require at the time of booking (e.g., specific subjects/content to be covered by docents, wheelchair access, etc.). Docent-led tours run for approximately two hours. Please let us know in advance if you would prefer more or less time for your tour.Please

services.name: Browse Exhibits
services.desc: Located on the grounds of a 19th-century military fort, Fort Walla Walla Museum provides an exciting and educational experience for the whole family. Walk through old Walla Walla, starting at the Museum’s iconic stagecoach. Discover stories from the Oregon Trail, see the oldest locomotive to operate in Washington State, watch a 33-mule team harvest a wheat field, and lock yourself in an old bucket cell from the Washington State Penitentiary. Programs and events are held on the Museum grounds all year, so immerse yourself in history by taking in a Living History performance or learn something new during our monthly After-Hours presentations.
